name: Binta Nkrumah-Wojciechowski-Kulkarni
location: Kessler Row — arms dealers and augmentation clinics, near Kedzie and Division
description:
Binta Nkrumah-Wojciechowski-Kulkarni is tall and rawboned, the kind of frame that suggests either malnutrition or efficiency depending on the decade. At 43, his expression defaults to a careful neutrality that took years of practice to maintain. The chrome is visible — subdermal weapon mount — pop-out blade in each forearm — and he makes no effort to hide it.

He inherited the role from a mentor who disappeared on a job four years ago — the mentor's gear, contacts, and unfinished business all came with it. He works as a sniper out of Kessler Row, taking contracts that match his skills and his risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

Binta Nkrumah-Wojciechowski-Kulkarni has survived long enough in the runner game to be either very good or very lucky, and he cultivates ambiguity on the topic.

core_fears: Betrayal by someone they trust — the only currency that matters
Dying alone in some alley and nobody noticing for weeks
Being identified by corporate facial recognition — living off-grid is survival
core_desires: The perfect run — one job so clean it becomes legend
Reputation — to be the name fixers whisper when the job absolutely cannot fail
Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of GLMZ
coping_mechanisms: Connection — finds someone to talk to, even if it's a bartender or a cat
Control — micromanages everything within reach to compensate for the chaos everywhere else
Isolates — retreats into their space when overwhelmed, emerges only for work
blind_spots: Assumes everyone has an angle because they always have an angle
Trusts technology more than people — machines don't betray
Cannot recognize when they're being manipulated by someone who genuinely seems to care

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Quiet and precise. Every word is measured. Silence does the heavy lifting.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rapid and dense — information-heavy sentences that demand attention.
verbal_tics: Speaks in clipped fragments when stressed — drops pronouns, articles, pleasantries
Uses old pre-collapse slang that nobody else remembers
example_lines: "Patience is the weapon. The rifle is just the delivery system."
"At this distance, the target is already dead. They just don't know it yet."
"One shot, one outcome. Everything else is theater."

story_hooks: A Tier 4 executive offers Nneka Lindqvist-Okafor a permanent position — the pay is obscene and the strings are invisible until they tighten
Nneka Lindqvist-Okafor discovers a job they completed last year was a setup for something much larger and much worse
Nneka Lindqvist-Okafor is offered a contract that would clear all their debts — the target is someone they respect
narrative_function: Nneka Lindqvist-Okafor represents the working professional of the runner world — competent, reliable, and slowly being consumed by a lifestyle that doesn't accommodate aging or doubt. His stories explore what happens when skill meets systemic injustice.
augmentations: Subdermal weapon mount — pop-out blade in each forearm. Neural dampener — blocks external hacking attempts, passive ICE in the brain
daily_life: Wakes early, runs maintenance on gear, checks dead drops and message boards for contracts. Eats when convenient, sleeps when possible. The days between jobs are spent maintaining contacts, updating equipment, and performing the low-grade paranoia that passes for self-care in the runner community.

strengths: social chameleon — adapts to any environment
weaknesses: augmentation dependency — performance drops sharply if chrome malfunctions
poor impulse control in specific triggers

decision_rules: Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
Will work with anyone once. Second time requires vouching from someone trusted.
Maintains a personal blacklist of clients who've burned runners — checks it religiously
Will take lower-paying jobs from trusted fixers over higher-paying jobs from unknowns
Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
escalation_ladder: 2. Evade — avoid the problem entirely if possible
3. Misdirect — create a distraction, redirect attention
4. Disable — targeted takedowns, quiet and efficient
5. Eliminate — when silence is no longer an option
6. Vanish — disappear completely, burn identity if necessary

interpersonal_modes.employers: Professional and transactional. The relationship is defined by the contract and nothing else.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Warm and protective within the crew, cold to everyone outside it. The circle is small by design.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Predatory focus. Threats are problems, and problems have solutions. The solution is usually kinetic.

stress_responses.low: Channels it into preparation — checks gear, reviews plans, contacts sources.
stress_responses.medium: Becomes curt and demanding. Efficiency overrides courtesy.
stress_responses.high: Goes quiet. The silence is not calm — it's the sound of every contingency being evaluated simultaneously.
stress_responses.critical: Berserker clarity. Everything becomes simple: survive. Deal with the rest later. The simplicity is almost peaceful.

contradictions: Presents as emotionless professional but is deeply affected by collateral damage
Advocates caution to others but takes insane risks personally — double standard they can't see
habits: Eats the same meal before every job — superstition masquerading as preference
Arrives fifteen minutes early to everything — late once, nearly died, never again
Never drinks anything they didn't see poured or open themselves
breaking_points: Being forced to choose between a crew member and the mission — and choosing wrong
Losing their primary augmentation — the one that defines their professional identity
Discovering their employer deliberately sent them into a death trap

physical_description.heritage: Diaspora blend: Sub-Saharan African (43.6%) as dominant ancestry stream, Eastern European (25.4%) providing bone structure refinement, South Asian (15.9%) contributing warmth and depth, East Asian (10.1%) adding subtle eye and eyelid contours, with minor Hispanic/Latin American (4.2%) and Southeast Asian (0.8%) ancestry enriching overall dimensional complexity. Facial structure reflects this intricate blend — strong, high cheekbones and defined jaw rooted in Sub-Saharan African heritage, modulated by Eastern European facial length and jaw geometry; South Asian fullness around lower face and lip structure providing balance; East Asian subtlety in eye shape, eyelid folds, and orbital spacing. The synthesis creates striking angular elegance with dimensional warmth.
physical_description.build: Rawboned and efficient — long-limbed with minimal body fat, the kind of frame that reads as either ascetic discipline or chronic deprivation. Shoulders broad but not heavy; chest defined without bulk. Suggests endurance over raw strength.
physical_description.skin_tone: Rich warm medium-to-deep brown — Sub-Saharan African as primary dominant tone, blended with Eastern European subtle luminosity undertones, South Asian golden-red warmth, and East Asian depth layers. The result is dimensional and complex across face and body, catching light with warm undertones while maintaining substantial depth.
physical_description.hair_style: Kept short and practical, no styling product. Greying at temples.
physical_description.complexion: Strongly angular face with prominent high cheekbones and decisive jaw — cheekbone prominence reflects Sub-Saharan African heritage, jaw structure and face length reflect Eastern European influence, South Asian fullness around the lower face and fuller lip structure providing balance, East Asian eye shape and eyelid contours adding subtle refinement. Skin weathered but maintained — signs of sun exposure and stress, minimal scarring on the face itself. Expression defaults to controlled neutrality; eyes rarely betray emotion. Three-day stubble is his baseline grooming state.
distinguishing_marks: Thin white scar running from left temple to cheekbone — old blade work, healed clean.
Burn mark on right shoulder blade — thermal weapon discharge, roughly 8cm diameter, pale and old.
Linear scarring along both forearms where the subdermal weapon mounts interface with skin — precise surgical lines, professionally installed, visible when arms are exposed.
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Subdermal weapon mounts visible as faint linear scars along both forearms; chrome catches light when he flexes or extends. The implants themselves are subcutaneous but the interface seams are evident to anyone who knows what to look for. No visible facial augmentation — the neural dampener is completely internal.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with economical precision — no wasted motion, weight always balanced. Stands with slight forward lean, as if perpetually in prone position. Hands rarely still; fingers are constantly performing micro-checks on equipment or assessing distance/angles. Eyes track exits and high ground automatically. Speaks quietly; listens more than talks.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 practical wear: worn but maintained tactical jacket (faded charcoal, synthetic polymer blend) over layered base wear. Cargo pants with reinforced thigh pockets and knee articulation — built-in flex panels for fieldwork. Steel-toed boots, scuffed but oiled. No logos or gang colors; everything is matte-finish or weathered to avoid light reflection. A single Φ-silver ring on his left thumb — old-school marker of runner status. No jewellery beyond that. Clothes smell like gun oil and synthetic detergent.

image_prompt: A tall, lean male figure of mixed Sub-Saharan African, Eastern European, and South Asian heritage standing in dim neon-lit near-future megacity setting, 2226. Rich warm medium-deep brown skin with golden-red undertones and subtle luminosity. Strongly angular face with high prominent cheekbones and decisive jaw, deep brown unaugmented eyes with East Asian subtle eyelid contours, three-day stubble. Dark brown hair naturally textured, short with greying at temples. Old white scar running left temple to cheekbone, weathered sun-exposed complexion. 188cm tall, rawboned efficient build, long-limbed. Wearing faded charcoal synthetic tactical jacket over layered base, reinforced cargo pants with flex panels, scuffed steel-toed boots oiled black. Linear surgical scars visible on both forearms where subdermal weapon mounts interface. Φ-silver ring on left thumb. Posture slightly forward-leaning, economical precise movement, hands subtly assessing environment, eyes tracking exits. Standing in industrial rain-slicked alley or dimly-lit runner safe house, cool blues and amber streetlight, gun oil and synthetic detergent smell, controlled neutral expression, mood tense and cautious --ar 2:3 --v 6
